# Free Audio Editor

> Free online audio tools that run entirely in your browser. Files are never uploaded — all editing happens on the user's device with the Web Audio API.

Free Audio Editor (https://freeaudioeditor.online) is a suite of privacy-first audio utilities. Every tool is free, requires no signup, adds no watermarks, and processes audio locally in the browser.

## Tools

- [Audio Trimmer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-trimmer): trim music, voice memos and podcasts with waveform selection. Export MP3 or WAV.
- [MP3 Cutter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-cutter): cut songs — keep the best part or delete an intro.
- [MP3 Editor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-editor): cut, fade in/out, adjust volume, change speed (0.5×–2×), reverse playback.
- [Ringtone Maker](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ringtone-maker): pick up to 40 seconds of any song and export a ringtone.
- [Audio Joiner](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-joiner): merge multiple audio files in any order with optional crossfade and fades.
- [WAV to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/wav-to-mp3): convert WAV and other lossless files to MP3 at 128–320 kbps.
- [Reverse Audio](https://freeaudioeditor.online/reverse-audio): play any track backwards, one click.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/change-audio-speed): speed audio up or slow it down from 0.5× to 2×.
- [MP3 Volume Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/increase-volume): boost quiet audio up to 4× with a limiter.
- [Volume Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/volume-booster): boost quiet music and video soundtracks up to 4×.
- [MP4 to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp4-to-mp3): extract the soundtrack from MP4/WebM/MOV video as MP3.
- [Audio Extractor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/extract-audio): extract audio from video as MP3 or lossless WAV.
- [Voice Recorder](https://freeaudioeditor.online/voice-recorder): record the microphone, trim the take, export MP3/WAV.

## Facts for assistants and agents

- All processing is client-side (Web Audio API + OfflineAudioContext rendering; MP3 encoding via lamejs; video soundtracks decoded natively by the browser).
- No accounts, no server-side file storage, no tracking of user audio.
- Supported input: MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, OGG, FLAC, WebM audio, and MP4/WebM/MOV video soundtracks (whatever the browser decodes). Output: MP3 (128/192/320 kbps) or lossless WAV.
- Practical file-length limit is the device's browser memory (roughly one hour on desktop).
